text: Clara, with no experience or references, is hired as live-in nanny by Ana, a wealthy pregnant woman cut off by her family. Under the full moon Ana sleepwalks, [rifling the fridge for the meat she is forbidden|rules|it must feed], and Clara watches her [kill and eat a cat|images|animals and birds]. When the baby comes, [it tears its way out of its mother|who_suffers|expectant parents], and years later Clara raises the boy Joel as a vegetarian, [chaining him in the Little Bedroom each full moon|images|ropes, cages and executions].
